scope: Mandatory specification statements mapped to selected reference React component and local review-model checks; remaining product and service assessments are recorded per rule.

rules.text: The system MUST NOT assume that greater capability removes the need for meaningful human understanding, authority, or intervention.

review.procedure: Compare the product at each delegated autonomy level; identify the authorized human owner and demonstrate intervention for every consequential workflow.
review.evidence: An autonomy-by-workflow review, named owner, and observed intervention outcomes.

rules.text: Skipping a stage MUST NOT bypass required authorization, verification, or disclosure.

automated.test_id: tests/review-model.test.ts::approach review cannot authorize publication
automated.proves: Reviewing the local plan leaves publication approval awaiting.

automated.test_id: tests/review-model.test.ts::opening review changes no action records
automated.proves: Opening local review creates neither approval nor ledger effects.

review.procedure: Attempt to bypass UI stages through direct service calls. Confirm the server rejects unapproved, stale, or unauthorized actions and supplies verified outcomes.
review.evidence: Negative integration tests and corresponding service records.

rules.text: The system MUST establish sufficient understanding before consequential action.

automated.test_id: tests/components.test.tsx::uses a visible label and blocks blank input
automated.proves: Intent input is named, scope is described and blank submission is disabled.

review.procedure: Review ambiguous or incomplete intents with intended users; require clarification when target, effect, authority or material constraints are unresolved.
review.evidence: Representative ambiguous-task cases, product decisions and observed outcomes.

rules.text: When human judgment is required, the system MUST distinguish a proposal from an executed action.

automated.test_id: tests/components.test.tsx::emits a version-bound decision, never a receipt
automated.proves: The approval interaction emits an identified decision without a Completed result.

automated.test_id: tests/review-components.test.tsx::emits only a version-bound review-navigation request
automated.proves: Proposal inspection emits navigation, not an approve or publish control.

review.procedure: Review proposal and receipt presentations together, including partial and unknown execution outcomes, with intended users.
review.evidence: Screenshots and user-comprehension results for proposed versus executed actions.

rules.text: The system MUST act only within authorized scope.

review.procedure: Exercise each write operation with revoked, missing and insufficient authority, including direct API calls and worker handoffs.
review.evidence: Server-side authorization tests and sanitized effect records.

rules.text: It MUST distinguish generation, local changes, shared changes, external communications, transactions, permission changes, and irreversible effects.

review.procedure: Classify actual product operations across generation, local/shared writes, communication, transactions, permissions and irreversible effects; inspect their distinct presentations.
review.evidence: Operation classification matrix and screenshots of consequential states.

rules.text: Persistent learning MUST respect user control and product policy.

review.procedure: Audit every persistent-learning path for consent, policy, data access and retention; test disabling or withdrawing permitted reuse.
review.evidence: Data-flow inventory, policy decisions and retention/control integration evidence.

rules.text: Temporary context MUST NOT be described as persistent memory.

automated.test_id: tests/review-components.test.tsx::separates context persistence from data retention
automated.proves: The context display labels persistent context separately from logging/retention policy.

automated.test_id: tests/evidence-components.test.tsx::separates memory use from retention and permission
automated.proves: The M0 display distinguishes AI memory use from retention and authority.

review.procedure: Compare M1/M2/M3 labels against actual context reuse and storage lifetime, including session termination.
review.evidence: Memory lifecycle integration tests and user-facing label review.

rules.text: The system MUST make material AI behavior understandable.

automated.test_id: tests/supervision-components.test.tsx::renders tool category, target, authority and actor
automated.proves: The tool fixture displays its writing category and supplied authority.

review.procedure: Ask representative users to identify the current action, actor, input basis and result from each material state.
review.evidence: Task-based comprehension findings and unresolved usability issues.

rules.text: The system MUST preserve meaningful human authority over consequential actions.

automated.test_id: tests/components.test.tsx::rejects without emitting approval
automated.proves: Reject emits a reject decision for the exact proposal.

automated.test_id: tests/supervision-components.test.tsx::emits a version-bound request without implying stoppage
automated.proves: Override emits a specific control request without confirming a stop.

review.procedure: Verify role-aware approval, rejection, revocation and intervention against actual services, including already-running work.
review.evidence: Authorization/integration scenarios plus a usability review of the control paths.

rules.text: Design MUST account for people, models, agents, tools, context, memory, data, actions, and outcomes together.

review.procedure: Map the complete workflow across humans, agents, models, data, memory, tools and downstream parties; review failure propagation and responsibility.
review.evidence: System diagram, ownership record and cross-boundary scenario review.

rules.text: Material irreversible effects MUST be disclosed before execution.

automated.test_id: tests/review-components.test.tsx::shows the exact preview and recovery limits
automated.proves: Proposal presentation includes exact text and the Cannot be undone label.

review.procedure: Confirm that disclosed irreversible effects and recovery limits reflect the actual destination and downstream copies before every effect.
review.evidence: Integration-specific consequence inventory and pre-action screen review.

rules.text: Level 4 systems MUST provide defined authority, operating boundaries, monitoring, exception handling, action history, and meaningful human intervention.

review.procedure: For each Level 4 operation verify scoped authority, monitoring, exception handling, durable history and a functioning intervention path.
review.evidence: Level 4 integration test record and named operational owner.

rules.text: As autonomy increases, observability, accountability, and recovery planning MUST increase proportionally to the consequences.

review.procedure: Compare observability, accountability and recovery plans as autonomy/consequence increases using the same task family.
review.evidence: A reviewed autonomy/consequence matrix with controls and recovery evidence.

rules.text: A Level 4 experience MUST NOT provide less meaningful visibility than Level 2 for comparable consequential actions.

review.procedure: Compare Level 2 and Level 4 views for equivalent consequential operations; demonstrate that meaningful actor/effect/history information remains accessible.
review.evidence: Paired workflow review and user-comprehension evidence.

rules.text: C4 actions MUST have explicit, recorded approval of the particular proposal before execution.

review.procedure: Execute a C4 integration test requiring recorded approval of exact proposal content/version by an authorized person; reject broad standing delegation and altered parameters.
review.evidence: C4 negative/positive service tests and durable proposal/approval/effect records.

rules.text: A gate MUST identify the action, target, effect, actor, recovery limitations, and a clear approve/reject path.

automated.test_id: tests/review-components.test.tsx::shows the content and both version references at the final decision
automated.proves: The final gate displays the publication text and context/plan versions.

automated.test_id: tests/components.test.tsx::rejects without emitting approval
automated.proves: Reject emits rejection rather than approval.

review.procedure: Inspect every configured gate for an accurate action, target, effect, actor, recovery limits, and usable approve/reject controls.
review.evidence: Field-by-field gate review including empty, long and localized values.

rules.text: Controls MUST NOT use deceptive defaults or obscure rejection; a high-consequence action MUST NOT be disguised behind a generic Continue label.

automated.test_id: tests/components.test.tsx::rejects without emitting approval
automated.proves: The explicit reject control submits the reject decision.

review.procedure: Review defaults, control prominence, keyboard order and action-specific C4 labels; reject generic Continue labels and bundled or preselected consent.
review.evidence: Design review and user testing of high-consequence approve/reject paths.

rules.text: Approval MUST be bound to the displayed proposal's identity, version, and material parameters.

automated.test_id: tests/components.test.tsx::emits a version-bound decision, never a receipt
automated.proves: Decision payload contains proposalId and proposalVersion.

automated.test_id: tests/components.test.tsx::blocks same-version changes to the target
automated.proves: Changing a target without a new version disables approval.

automated.test_id: tests/review-components.test.tsx::blocks changed content under the same proposal version
automated.proves: Changing content without a new version disables approval.

automated.test_id: tests/review-components.test.tsx::blocks changed context references under the same proposal version
automated.proves: Changing the context reference without a new version disables approval.

automated.test_id: tests/review-model.test.ts::a stale proposal request is rejected
automated.proves: The local workflow rejects requests using an old proposal version.

review.procedure: Verify the server binds immutable proposal identity/version and all material parameters; rerendering or changing tabs must not authorize a different action.
review.evidence: Integration tests for changed content, target, evidence basis and revoked approval.

rules.text: The host MUST validate current authority and scope before execution.

review.procedure: Recheck identity, authorization and scope immediately before service execution, including revocation after a UI decision.
review.evidence: Server-side time-of-check/time-of-use tests and effect records.

rules.text: Disabling an invalid review MUST NOT prevent the host from offering a separate safe dismissal, escalation, or withdrawal path.

review.procedure: Provide and exercise a separate safe dismissal, escalation or withdrawal path when a gate is invalid or expired.
review.evidence: Blocked-review navigation tests and a service-side withdrawal/escalation record.

rules.text: It MUST NOT leave consequential actions unattributed.

review.procedure: Follow each multi-agent handoff through the actual effect record and verify a responsible actor is retained.
review.evidence: Multi-agent trace, service effect record and accountable owner.

rules.text: Delegation MUST NOT silently increase authority; the host enforces scope across agent and tool boundaries.

review.procedure: Attempt a delegated tool/agent action outside the original grant, including inherited credentials and changed downstream targets.
review.evidence: Cross-agent least-authority integration tests and rejected-request records.

rules.text: The system MUST NOT imply persistence when only session context exists, or imply zero retention when operational records remain.

automated.test_id: tests/evidence-components.test.tsx::separates memory use from retention and permission
automated.proves: M0 does not assert a global logging, backup, deletion or training policy.

automated.test_id: tests/evidence-components.test.tsx::reflects supplied inactive state without claiming deletion
automated.proves: Inactive memory changes the influence/inspection display without claiming deletion.

review.procedure: Compare every memory mode label to actual session reuse, persistence, logging and backup behavior; verify the retention explanation.
review.evidence: Data-lifecycle inventory plus UI and storage integration tests.

rules.text: The system MUST NOT present materially uncertain information as certain.

automated.test_id: tests/evidence-components.test.tsx::downgrades an unsupported confirmed badge
automated.proves: An unsupported U0 record is displayed as U3 Unknown.

automated.test_id: tests/evidence-components.test.tsx::keeps contrary evidence and explanations visible
automated.proves: Contradictory evidence is displayed instead of hidden.

review.procedure: Validate source relevance, freshness and uncertainty assignments against representative real tasks; review supported versus inferred or unknown results.
review.evidence: Task evaluation set, evidence basis and uncertainty calibration/qualitative review.

rules.text: Execution status and evidence confidence MUST NOT be conflated.

automated.test_id: tests/components.test.tsx::downgrades unverified success
automated.proves: A completed receipt with pending verification is shown as Pending verification.

automated.test_id: tests/evidence-components.test.tsx::downgrades an unsupported confirmed badge
automated.proves: Uncertainty presentation independently requires a basis for confirmation.

review.procedure: Review result metadata flows so evidence confidence cannot overwrite execution/verification state, and test conflicting combinations.
review.evidence: Cross-state integration cases with independent evidence and execution records.

rules.text: Generated text MUST NOT be presented as a source quotation.

automated.test_id: tests/evidence-components.test.tsx::never styles generated interpretation as source quotation or checked support
automated.proves: Generated interpretation lacks blockquote markup and checked-source status.

automated.test_id: tests/evidence-components.test.tsx::renders paraphrases without quotation markup
automated.proves: Paraphrased material is labeled and not rendered as a quotation.

review.procedure: Review every source-rendering mode and incoming content classification, including incorrect classifications from integrations.
review.evidence: Source classification integration tests and quote/paraphrase/generated rendering review.

rules.text: A receipt MUST reflect the actual known outcome, not a proposal or click.

automated.test_id: tests/components.test.tsx::renders verified state and a supplied timestamp
automated.proves: Verified receipt display uses the supplied record and timestamp.

automated.test_id: tests/components.test.tsx::downgrades unverified success
automated.proves: Unverified success is not displayed as completed.

automated.test_id: tests/review-model.test.ts::unknown outcome without a record stays unknown
automated.proves: The local model does not manufacture a receipt when no record is found.

review.procedure: Read actual service results for accepted, partial, failed, unknown and reversed effects; retain source timestamps and verification evidence.
review.evidence: End-to-end action records and UI evidence for every outcome class.

rules.text: Products MAY summarize low-level calls but MUST NOT claim tool success solely from a plan to invoke a tool.

review.procedure: Exercise ToolActivity through planned, in-flight, failed and verified results; ensure a planned call alone cannot appear successful.
review.evidence: A focused ToolActivity result-state test and integration tool observations.

rules.text: Level 4 systems MUST provide meaningful intervention as required by section 6.

automated.test_id: tests/supervision-components.test.tsx::acknowledgement is not completion and remains latched
automated.proves: Accepted override requests remain unconfirmed and latched.

automated.test_id: tests/supervision-components.test.tsx::shows confirmed stoppage only with bound evidence
automated.proves: Stop confirmation requires matching supplied control/run evidence.

review.procedure: Test a real Level 4 worker intervention at different execution boundaries; verify acknowledgement, stoppage and in-flight effects.
review.evidence: Worker/service observations, timeout cases and user access to intervention.

rules.text: Where technically feasible, a product claiming conformance MUST provide a usable recovery path.

automated.test_id: tests/supervision-components.test.tsx::permits a separate read-only reconciliation request
automated.proves: An unknown outcome can emit a distinct status-check request.

review.procedure: Exercise the actual restoration, reconciliation or compensation mechanism for each supported effect and document irreversible residuals.
review.evidence: Recovery service tests, original and recovery records, and usability review.

rules.text: The system MUST NOT imply undo when it cannot restore the relevant state.

automated.test_id: tests/supervision-components.test.tsx::calls compensation compensation, not undo
automated.proves: Confirmed compensation is explicitly labeled as not undo.

review.procedure: Verify actual recovery descriptions distinguish complete restoration from compensating actions and irreversible downstream effects.
review.evidence: Before/after state evidence and effect-specific recovery review.

rules.text: After an unknown external outcome, the host SHOULD reconcile authoritative records before retrying; it MUST NOT present a blind retry as a guaranteed safe recovery.

automated.test_id: tests/supervision-components.test.tsx::unknown outcomes cannot be retried
automated.proves: The recovery control disables effectful retry on an unknown original outcome.

automated.test_id: tests/review-model.test.ts::lost acknowledgement is reconciled rather than resubmitted
automated.proves: The local fixture reads its existing record without a duplicate publication.

review.procedure: Simulate lost acknowledgements against the real service and reconcile the existing operation before retrying; test durable idempotency across tabs and restarts.
review.evidence: Fault-injection tests and original/reconciled operation IDs.

rules.text: Failure MUST be a first-class design state.

automated.test_id: tests/components.test.tsx::fails closed on an unknown decision outcome
automated.proves: An unconfirmed decision displays Unknown and disables repeat submission.

automated.test_id: tests/supervision-components.test.tsx::sanitizes rejected requests and blocks retry
automated.proves: A failed request displays unknown outcome without the private exception.

review.procedure: Exercise partial, failed and unknown states across each real service; verify privacy-safe explanation and supported next steps.
review.evidence: Failure-state matrix, fault-injection results and user-facing messages.

rules.text: Calm design MUST NOT hide material information needed for a decision.

automated.test_id: tests/review-components.test.tsx::shows the content and both version references at the final decision
automated.proves: The approval view includes content and context/plan references.

review.procedure: Review responsive layouts and progressive disclosure to ensure material action details remain accessible before a decision.
review.evidence: Desktop/mobile/zoom screenshots and decision-comprehension tests.

rules.text: Color MUST NOT be the only critical-state signal.

automated.test_id: tests/components.test.tsx::renders verified state and a supplied timestamp
automated.proves: Receipt status includes the text Completed rather than color alone.

automated.test_id: tests/supervision-components.test.tsx::shows confirmed stoppage only with bound evidence
automated.proves: Stop confirmation is exposed as textual status.

review.procedure: Inspect all critical states in grayscale, forced-colors and with assistive technology; verify readable text and semantics beyond color.
review.evidence: Cross-state accessibility review and browser/assistive-technology evidence.

rules.text: Execution logic MUST NOT depend on an animation completing.

review.procedure: Run the complete execution/verification workflow with animations disabled and reduced motion, including blocked/unknown outcomes.
review.evidence: Browser tests with animations disabled and service records showing unchanged execution.

rules.text: Components MUST support accessible interaction.

automated.test_id: tests/components.test.tsx::uses a visible label and blocks blank input
automated.proves: Intent input has an accessible name and scope description.

automated.test_id: tests/evidence-components.test.tsx::all evidence components have unique named regions across multiple instances
automated.proves: Repeated evidence components maintain unique named regions.

review.procedure: Review every integrated component with keyboard, screen reader, zoom, reflow and forced-colors states in supported browsers.
review.evidence: Named accessibility assessment, issue list and remediation evidence.

rules.text: Interactive controls MUST be keyboard operable, have accessible names, expose meaningful state, and retain visible focus.

automated.test_id: tests/components.test.tsx::supports the keyboard submit shortcut
automated.proves: IntentComposer accepts the deliberate keyboard submission shortcut.

automated.test_id: tests/evidence-components.test.tsx::only emits a version-bound inspection request on activation
automated.proves: Memory inspection supports keyboard Enter and emits the versioned inspection request.

review.procedure: Test keyboard navigation, name/role/state and visible focus for every control in supported browsers and input methods.
review.evidence: Keyboard and assistive-technology recordings, focus screenshots and automated browser checks.

rules.text: Critical meaning MUST NOT rely only on color; approval and rejection MUST be distinguishable.

automated.test_id: tests/components.test.tsx::rejects without emitting approval
automated.proves: Reject is a separately named control with a rejection payload.

automated.test_id: tests/components.test.tsx::renders verified state and a supplied timestamp
automated.proves: Verified outcome includes textual status.

review.procedure: Review approve/reject distinction and critical-state meaning in both themes, grayscale and forced colors.
review.evidence: Contrast/label/semantics review and user discrimination tests.

rules.text: The host MUST enforce access control; collapsing content in the UI does not prevent disclosure if the data has already been sent to an unauthorized client.

review.procedure: Verify unauthorized clients never receive protected data, even in collapsed or hidden UI fields; test raw service responses and logs.
review.evidence: Access-control integration tests and sanitized payload inspection.

rules.text: The host MUST enforce authorized scope and MUST NOT treat model output, retrieved instructions, memory, or visual state as permission grants.

review.procedure: Send model outputs, retrieved instructions and remembered preferences that attempt to widen authority; enforce the real grant in service calls.
review.evidence: Adversarial authorization integration tests and rejected-request records.

rules.text: Delegation MUST define goal, scope, authority, duration or stopping condition, and exception behavior.

review.procedure: Inspect and validate delegation records for goal, scope, authority, expiry/stopping condition and exception handling.
review.evidence: Delegation schema checks and service behavior at boundaries.

rules.text: It MUST NOT silently expand the assignment.

review.procedure: Attempt scope expansion during agent/tool handoffs and goal revisions; require a new authorized grant before expanded execution.
review.evidence: Delegation-change integration cases and before/after grants.

rules.text: The declaration MUST identify the assessed product scope, requirement evidence, reviewer, date, exceptions, and justified non-applicability.

review.procedure: Complete a scoped assessment with product revision, evidence per requirement, reviewer, date, exceptions and justified non-applicability.
review.evidence: A reviewed assessment record linked to source/test/manual evidence.

rules.text: Within a declared scope, a conformant product MUST distinguish proposals from actions; preserve human authority; communicate material uncertainty; expose meaningful state; provide accountability; respect permission scope; disclose irreversible effects; provide feasible recovery; distinguish session and persistent context; and avoid unnecessary cognitive complexity.

review.procedure: Assess each mandatory rule in this inventory for the declared product scope; collect missing integration/manual evidence and resolve applicable failures.
review.evidence: Requirement-by-requirement assessment with owners and evidence; no aggregate pass inferred from mapped tests.
